seo.defaultDescription: Discover the latest Hindi, Bollywood, Hollywood and South dubbed movies on FilmySoar.

content.homeDescription: Find movies and series you will want to talk about tomorrow.

about.title: About Us
about.intro: FilmyFly makes movie discovery simple, fast, and enjoyable.

sections.heading: Our purpose
sections.body: We organize movie and series information so visitors can quickly discover stories that match their mood.

sections.heading: Built for people
sections.body: FilmyFly is designed mobile-first, with a clean interface, fast pages, and useful search and category browsing.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.intro: Have a question, correction, or partnership idea? Contact the FilmyFly team.

sections.heading: General support
sections.body: For website feedback, broken links, metadata corrections, or general questions, email us with the relevant page URL.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how FilmyFly handles information when you use the website.

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body: FilmyFly does not require an account for browsing. Limited technical information may be processed by hosting, analytics, security, or API providers to operate and protect the website.

sections.heading: Cookies and analytics
sections.body: If analytics or cookies are enabled, they are used to understand website performance and improve the experience. You can control cookies through your browser settings.

sections.heading: Third-party links
sections.body: The website may link to third-party services. Their privacy practices are governed by their own policies.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For privacy questions or data requests, contact the website owner using the email listed on the Contact Us page.

dmca.title: DMCA
dmca.intro: FilmyFly respects copyright owners and responds to valid copyright complaints.

sections.heading: Submit a notice
sections.body: Send a written notice identifying the copyrighted work, the allegedly infringing URL, your contact details, a good-faith statement, and confirmation that the information is accurate.

sections.heading: Where to send it
sections.body: Email a complete copyright notice to the contact address listed on the Contact Us page. Incomplete notices may delay processing.

movieRequest.title: Movie Request
movieRequest.intro: Can’t find a movie or series? Send us the title and useful details.

sections.heading: Include these details
sections.body: Please include the exact title, release year, language, season or episode information, and any alternate title. Requests are reviewed when possible and are not guaranteed.

instructions.changeBrand: Update site.name, branding.logoText, branding.logoMark, and organization.name.
instructions.changeDomain: Update site.domain, organization.url, and organization.logo together.
instructions.changeSeo: Update seo.defaultTitle, seo.defaultDescription, seo.keywords, and seo.defaultImage.
instructions.secrets: Never put API keys, database credentials, or private tokens in this file.
